correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=3 and distinct complex centers, Bézout with the common line yields sum_i m_i<=d and with each connecting line yields m_i+m_star<=d for every irreducible image curve outside the identified lines. Hence C.C>=m_star(d-m_star)>=0. These inequalities exhaust negative curves. Their intersection pairing shows (-1)-curve supports must be pairwise disjoint; when the common-line (-[n-1])-curve is present, its Schur complement is -(n-1)+k, giving k<=n-2. The four exhaustive support types produce the stated polynomial, total 2*3^n+2*2^n-3*n-2, and top coefficient 2^n-n. The standalone exact Bareiss/Sylvester checker independently examines all 2^(2n+2) subsets for n=3,4,5 and reproduces the formula; checks for larger n verify only the polynomial arithmetic, not the universal theorem.

value.rationale: A complete exact chamber-size polynomial for an infinite family with unbounded Picard rank, not an arbitrarily selected finite slice. The family is geometrically natural: a common line and one off-line point produce exactly n new connecting lines, and the resulting incidence structure admits an explicit Schur-bound classification. This yields z(X_n)=2*3^n+2*2^n-3n-2 and sharp maximal-support multiplicity 2^n-n, giving a positive family beyond the del Pezzo range where general-position high-point blowups have infinite chamber counts. Stable-base-locus geometry motivates the invariant independent of computation.
